cards.p: If the honest answer is no, the term is irrelevant. Negate it now.
At that rate, a perfectly normal search term still produces zero orders after 22 clicks less than 10% of the time.
Halve the rate and you roughly double the clicks needed: at 5%, about 45.

cards.k: High ACOS on a core term
cards.p: If a search term is central to what you sell, a poor result is a conversion problem, not a targeting problem.
